news.title: 2026年首个重磅AI IPO将至，但我选择观望
news.snippet: OpenAI与Anthropic有望启动公开上市，但市场对其估值与盈利能力存疑，投资者需谨慎对待。
news.raw_snippet: Both OpenAI and Anthropic are expected to make their public debuts this year, but another notable artificial intelligence (AI) company may beat them to the punch. That said, there's significant risk and uncertainty in the business that investors can't ignore, especially given its recent valuation and potential IPO price. Its wafer-scale engine architecture uses an entire silicon wafer, resulting in chips nearly 30 times the size of Nvidia's Blackwell B200 package, stuffing 19 times as many transistors per chip, according to the company's S-1 filing. Cerebras says its wafer-scale chips are up to 15 times faster than the leading GPU-based solutions when it comes to inference. Cerebras will have to dramatically scale its data center infrastructure operations to service OpenAI. The only way to mitigate that risk is to prove to potential customers that it can successfully scale its production and data center operations. So, while I like the technology Cerebras has developed, the price and execution risk will keep me from buying into the IPO.

news.title: 前DeepMind科学家David Silver为AI初创公司Ineffable募资11亿美元
news.snippet: DeepMind前研究员David Silver创立Ineffable，完成11亿美元融资，创AI领域新纪录，专注AGI研发。
news.raw_snippet: # Former Google DeepMind researcher's AI startup raises record $1.1 billion seed funding to pursue superintelligence. * A former Google DeepMind researcher announced on Monday a record $1.1 billion for his new AI lab. * Ineffable Intelligence garnered backing from Sequoia, Lightspeed, Nvidia and Google and emerged from stealth with a $5.1 billion valuation. * Silver is one of a number of former top researchers at Big Tech companies that've jumped ship to launch their own AI labs in recent months. A former top researcher at Google AI division DeepMind announced Monday a record $1.1 billion seed round for his months-old startup Ineffable Intelligence. The startup is pursuing superintelligence and was founded in late 2025 by UCL professor and former lead of DeepMind's reinforcement learning team David Silver. Silver is one of several former top researchers at Big Tech companies that've jumped ship to launch their own AI labs in recent months, with investors funnelling billions of dollars into the ventures.

news.title: 中国阻止Meta以20亿美元收购AI初创公司Manus
news.snippet: 中国反垄断监管机构正式否决Meta对Manus的收购案，该交易涉及Meta在VR/AR领域的重要布局。
news.raw_snippet: # China blocks Meta's $2bn acquisition of AI start-up Manus. Facebook-owner Meta's acquisition of AI start-up Manus has been blocked by Chinese regulators. Announced in late December, Meta said the deal - estimated to be worth around $2bn (£1.48bn) at the time - would see Manus' agents used to boost to its own AI across its platforms. It comes after months of scrutiny over Meta's acquisition of Manus by Chinese regulators. Analysts described the deal at the time as a "natural fit" for Meta, with founder and chief executive Mark Zuckerberg spurring the firm's AI development. China has a number of strict laws and regulations around its tech, including controls on their export or sale to foreign firms. The White House said on Friday it would work more closely with US AI firms to combat "industrial-scale campaigns" to steal advances in the technology - saying new information showed "foreign entities, principally based in China" were copying US models.

news.title: AI同时吞噬股市与VC资金：英伟达市值达5.2万亿美元，全球投资飙升至3309亿美元
news.snippet: AI热潮推动Nvidia市值突破5.2万亿美元，全球AI投资达3309亿美元，资本市场呈现爆发式增长态势。
news.raw_snippet: # AI Devours Stock Market and VC Funding Simultaneously: Nvidia Market Cap Hits $5.2 Trillion, Global Investment Explodes to $330.9 Billion. Nvidia's stock surged 4%, propelling its market capitalization to a record $5.26 trillion—widening its lead over Apple and Alphabet—following Qualcomm and OpenAI's collaboration announcement. On the same day, a Samjong KPMG report revealed that Q1 global VC investment more than doubled quarter-over-quarter to a record $330.9 billion (~462 trillion won), fueled by AI mega-deals including OpenAI's $122 billion round. As Nvidia (NVDA) shattered records by surpassing a $5.26 trillion market capitalization, the global venture capital (VC) market also logged its largest quarter ever at $330.9 billion (~462 trillion won), powered by mega-scale AI investments. Meanwhile, on the same day, Samjong KPMG published its 'Q1 2026 Global Venture Investment Trends' report, revealing that global VC investment totaled $330.9 billion in the first quarter—more than doubling from the previous quarter's $128.6 billion and setting an all-time record.

news.title: 银行CEO成功推出AI数字分身，并主持财报电话会议
news.snippet: 某银行首席执行官推出个人AI克隆体，首次由数字人主持财报会议，展示金融AI应用新突破。
news.raw_snippet: This bank CEO has successfully launched his AI clone — and it just led an earnings call "This bank CEO has successfully launched his AI clone — and it just led an earnings call"). This bank CEO has successfully launched his AI clone — and it just led an earnings call. ## Customers Bank CEO Sam Sidhu has taken a bold step into the future by deploying his AI clone on an earnings call, signalling a shift in how leaders operate. For decades, the voice on an earnings call carried weight because it was unmistakably human, measured, cautious, and often revealing in what it chose not to say. In a move that felt equal parts experiment and signal, Customers Bank CEO Sam Sidhu recently disclosed that analysts had been listening not to him, but to his artificial intelligence clone, reports CNBC. The lender has entered a multi-year partnership with OpenAI to embed engineers within the organisation, with the aim of automating core banking functions through AI agents.

news.title: Elon Musk与OpenAI CEO Sam Altman就AI控制权对簿公堂
news.snippet: 马斯克与阿尔特曼在法庭展开高风险对决，争夺OpenAI控制权及AGI发展方向，涉及AI安全与商业化分歧。

The trial, which started Monday with jury selection, centers on the 2015 birth of ChatGPT maker OpenAI as a nonprofit startup primarily funded by Musk before evolving into a capitalistic venture now valued at $852 billion. The trial’s outcome could sway the balance of power in AI — breakthrough technology that is increasingly being feared as a potential job killer and an existential threat to humanity’s survival. Those perceived risks are among the reasons that Musk, the world’s richest person, cites for filing an August 2024 lawsuit that will now be decided by a jury and U.S. District Judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers in Oakland, California. The civil lawsuit accuses Altman, OpenAI’s CEO, and his top lieutenant, Greg Brockman, of double-crossing Musk by straying from the San Francisco company’s founding mission to be an altruistic steward of a revolutionary technology.

news.title: Salesforce逆势招聘1000名毕业生与实习生，反驳AI失业论
news.snippet: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff宣布大规模招聘计划，强调AI增强而非替代人类，展现对人才市场的信心。
news.raw_snippet: Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff has announced that Salesforce will be hiring 1,000 new graduates and interns to “ride the AI exponential” and work on artificial intelligence projects – specifically Agentforce and Headless 360. On Saturday, Marc Benioff took to X to announce that Salesforce is looking to hire 1,000 new graduates and interns to work on some of the company’s most notable AI projects, including those that involve the proprietary AI Agentforce and the new agentic solution Headless 360. For some, this move from Salesforce has sparked debates over whether or not this is a classic fire and rehire tactic – letting go of seasoned talent in favor of hiring new (cheaper) graduates. But it does seem like a situation that Salesforce can’t get right either way – if it does not hire graduates, it’s not thinking about the future of the tech workforce, and if it does, it is taking opportunities away from seasoned professionals eager to break into the AI space.

news.raw_snippet: # Elon Musk and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman head to court in high-stakes showdown over AI. Technology tycoons Elon Musk and Sam Altman are poised to face off in a high-stakes trial revolving around the alleged betrayal, deceit and unbridled ambition that blurred the bickering billionaires’ once-shared vision for the development of artificial intelligence. The trial, which is scheduled to begin Monday with jury selection, centers on the 2015 birth of ChatGPT maker OpenAI as a nonprofit startup primarily funded by Musk before evolving into a capitalistic venture now valued at $852 billion. The trial’s outcome could sway the balance of power in AI — breakthrough technology that is increasingly being feared as a potential job killer and an existential threat to humanity’s survival. The civil lawsuit accuses Altman, OpenAI’s CEO, and his top lieutenant, Greg Brockman, of double-crossing Musk by straying from the San Francisco company’s founding mission to be an altruistic steward of a revolutionary technology.
